name: namma-bengaluru
description: An open-world GTA-style game set in Bengaluru, built with Three.js

scripts.app:windows: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop install && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dist:win

scripts.app:android: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/mobile install && npm --prefix apps/mobile run apk
